Read and change the session's configuration

spark_config.Rd

One function for the session's Spark SQL configuration, through Spark Connect's Config call. With no arguments it returns every setting. Unnamed strings name settings to read. Named arguments set settings, and a named NULL or NA unsets one, returning to the server's default. The server's warnings, such as for a deprecated setting, become R warnings.

Usage

spark_config(con, ...)

Arguments

con

A zuspark_connection.

...

Setting names to read, or name = value pairs to set. A logical value is sent as "true" or "false".

Value

Reading, a named character vector of values, NA for a setting that has none. Setting, the previous values invisibly, in the same form, so that passing them back restores the session: old <- spark_config(con, a = "1"), then do.call(spark_config, c(list(con), as.list(old))).

Examples

con <- spark_connect()
spark_config(con, "spark.sql.session.timeZone")
#> spark.sql.session.timeZone 
#>                  "Etc/UTC" 
old <- spark_config(con, spark.sql.session.timeZone = "UTC")
do.call(spark_config, c(list(con), as.list(old)))
spark_disconnect(con)
